entities.summary:
Hermann IV of Hesse was the Archbishop-Elector of Cologne from 1480 to 1508 and the Prince-Bishop of Paderborn from 1498 to 1508.

Born in an unknown year, Hermann IV held significant positions in the Holy Roman Empire, showcasing his influence in the complex web of ecclesiastical and secular power structures of the time.

During his tenure, Hermann IV navigated the tumultuous landscape of the late 15th century, including the Protestant Reformation and the rise of the Habsburgs.

His legacy can be seen in the ongoing religious and political tensions that characterized the region, as well as the lasting impact of the Reformation on the development of Christianity in Europe.

One enduring testament to Hermann IV's lasting presence is the numerous coins and seals bearing his image, a vivid reminder of his enduring legacy in the annals of history.
